item.title: Fall Semester Library Building Hours and Student Success Center Drop-In Tutoring
item.description: As we get ready to welcome students and faculty for the new semester, RPI Libraries is pleased to share our standard building hours for Fall 2026 starting Thu, Aug 27. Also, mark your calendars: Drop-In Tutoring begins Wed, Sept 9 in the Student Success Center on the first floor of Folsom Library. Drop-in tutoring is available for many core undergraduate courses. To see our building hours and the complete drop-in tutoring schedule, view the full announcement.
item.author: Students

item.title: New Graduate Students’ Welcome and Resource Fair
item.description: Date: Tuesday, August 25, 2026 12:00 PM - 3:00 PM - All incoming Master’s and Ph.D. students are invited to join us for lunch, where we will share information and tips for your time at RPI, followed by a resource fair.
item.author: Students

item.title: Center for Materials, Devices and Integrated Systems (CMDIS) Facilities Open House 2026
item.description: Center for Materials, Devices and Integrated Systems (CMDIS) invites you to the Facilities Open House on Wednesday, September 9th. Sign-up for facility tours to learn about new acquisitions, tools, instrumentation capabilities, fabrication and characterization techniques. Get information about educational programs and short courses. Meet with our technical team and discuss how we can help your research. The event will be followed by BBQ. Sign-up to tours by 09/04.

item.title: Houston Field House Restricted Access and Parking
item.description: On Wednesday morning, August 19, access to the Houston Field House and C-Lot parking near Harkness Field will be restricted due to construction activities. Regular traffic access and parking are expected to resume by 1:00 p.m.

item.title: 2026 Founders Award of Excellence Nominations Due
item.description:
Date: Saturday, August 29, 2026 (all day) - The Founders Award of Excellence was established in 1994 to honor students who embody the qualities of creativity, discovery, and leadership, and the values of pride and responsibility. The award includes a cash prize, a special certificate, and recognition by faculty, staff, and peers at the Honors Convocation ceremony. Nominations should be submitted via our Qualtrics Form (available in link) no later than Saturday, August 29.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
